statement: Baba Yaga is a World 1 mini boss located in Birch Enclave a portal off the Valley of the Beans
Baba Yaga is a fairly simple boss to fight
Baba Yaga requires 150 accuracy for a 5% hit chance
Baba Yaga requires 450 accuracy for a 100% hit chance
466 defense is required to avoid all damage from Baba Yaga
She only damages by walking over you; with 393 defense she did about 2 damage to him
Avoid damage without enough defense by climbing a light-colored tree and waiting for her to pass then come back down and keep fighting
Baba Yaga dies quickly to abilities and takes about a minute to kill
Baba Yaga drops Flowies which is a quest item in The Big Tree
Baba Yaga drops the Baba Yaga Card
Baba Yaga has a rare chance to drop Baba Yaga Baby Eggs
The baby eggs currently have no use
Worth stocking up on the eggs now since pets are talked about for future patches so you can get pets when released
Pets are not confirmed yet but something to look forward to
She can drop the Frothy Malk and the Just XP Talent book
You need at least 1 point in the talent in the Tasks Merit Shop to have a chance to drop the books
The books are decently good so you want a chance to find them
